title: Astrid and the House
author: Mara Joubert
blurb: Casper Thornbury, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
